items.title: Phil Schaap interviewed by Monk Rowe, Toronto, Canada, January 9, 2003

ctx.x: Yeah usually it’s double for the leader. But the scale, and also I paid the union dues. In fact I carved out that 802’s AF of M, although David Sheldon can verify this, although I’m not a member of the musician’s local, I was the delegate of the local 802 American Federal of Musicians for the address 2913 Broadway in Manhattan. Just for that address. And I went down to the union on Tuesdays and I think gave $28.45 every Tuesday. This is thirty years ago. And then the money got better. And of course certain acts —…
